cohorts: Fixed 217 Moller model hosts and 45 Walsh model hosts; no reselection
known_information: Distinct BioSample strings, previous within-Moller genome summaries and prediction outcomes are already known. Cross-cohort genomic similarities have not been computed in this work cycle.
method: sourmash MinHash n=0 ksize=31 scaled=1000; add all FASTA contigs with force=True; compare all 9765 cross-cohort pairs
report: All pair similarities, nearest Moller genome for every Walsh host, counts at fixed descriptive thresholds 0.95 and 0.99, FASTA input checksums and accessions
interpretation: Thresholds flag similarity, not proof of shared isolate identity. No phenotype-driven exclusions or new prediction fitting. Distinct accessions alone do not establish independent strains.
validation: Recompute a fixed first 10 pairs from the existing within-Moller table and compare to stored similarities. No outcome columns used in genomic computation.
